h:
这是一个简单的 FLux Comfyui 工作流程，我认为它可以让事情变得简单。

它使用 Use Everywhere 节点集合 (https://github.com/chrisgoringe/cg-use-everywhere）隐藏所有混乱。我还将大部分节点隐藏在需要一些用户输入的节点后面（您可能会觉得我隐藏的一些节点是必需的，因此如果您愿意，可以将它们放在前面）

我附上了工作流程的“分解”版本，以便您可以看到外观背后的全部内容。

这个工作流程并没有做任何花哨的事情，它只是允许您使用 Flux 和/或 Lora 生成图像。

o.en:
This is a simple FLux Comfyui workflow, which I think keeps things straight forward.

It uses the Use Everywhere collection of nodes (https://github.com/chrisgoringe/cg-use-everywhere) to hide away all the mess. I have also hidden most of the nodes behind those that will require some user input, (you may feel some of the nodes I've hidden are required, so they can be brought to the fore should you wish)

I have attached an 'exploded' version of the workflow so you can see what is all behind the facade.

This workflow doesn't do anything fancy, it just allows you to produce an image with Flux and/or a Lora.
